name: A Very Crooked Christmas
source:
There's a part-time vacancy at a magical sweet shop in York...A year before the apprentice arrives. The Crooked Man desperately needs to run some errands in the run-up to Christmas and requires a babysitter manager for his two mischievous familiars, Jack and Jill. 

Serve a collection of endearing customers, pair them with their dream orders and find out what the Crooked Man is really up to… 

[From [url=https://seraten04.itch.io/a-very-crooked-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
约克的一家神奇糖果店有一个兼职空缺……学徒到来的前一年。弯曲的人迫切需要在圣诞节前处理一些杂事，并需要一名保姆经理来照顾他的两个顽皮的朋友杰克和吉尔。

为一群可爱的顾客提供服务，将他们与他们梦想的订单配对，并找出弯曲的人真正在做什么…… 

[来自[url=https://seraten04.itch.io/a-very-crooked-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
